hooks.command: grep -qiE 'sk-ant-|sk_live_|sk_test_|rk_live_|whsec_|ghp_|gho_|ghs_|github_pat_|BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY|STRIPE_SECRET|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AUTHORIZATION: basic' && { echo 'Blocked: possible secret in command' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

grep -qE '\bgh\b[^|;&]*(--body-file|--input|[[:space:]]-F)' && { echo 'Blocked: --body-file/-F/--input in a gh command publishes file content without going through the command secret filter; publish with --body and reviewed text instead' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
